fields.text: Style: clean SaaS dashboard. White background, #1a1a2e text, indigo #4f46e5 primary, 8px spacing grid, rounded-lg cards, Inter-like sans-serif. Light mode.

fields.system: You write image prompts for UI mockups. Given a feature description and a style guide, reply with ONE detailed image prompt for a screenshot-style mockup of that screen: name every layout region and its position, spacing, the exact palette from the style guide, and realistic short UI labels (2-4 words each). Flat desktop screenshot, no browser chrome, no hands or devices, no walls of placeholder text. Reply with the prompt only.
